doc: Tale of Two Wastelands (TTW) lane: curated rules for quests that exist only in a TTW install (TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm). Loaded by tools/coverage/build_rules.py only when the quest data contains TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm, so a plain New Vegas rules.json is unchanged. Rule kinds are the existing vocabulary (tools/coverage/rules.py).

rules.why: TTWTrainTripActivatorScript (TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm:008D20) on the engine-car switch (TTWTrainElectricalSwitch02, refs 0020C8 in TTWTrainEngine01a and 002130 in TTWTrainEngine01b) sets TTWTrainTripQuest.iTravel; the quest script then moves the player to the other wasteland. The party must be in the departing engine car before it leaves.

TTWTrainTripQuestScript (TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm:008D1F) runs Player.MoveTo TTWNVTrainEngineXMarker (in TTWTrainEngine01a) or TTWDCTrainEngineXMarker (in TTWTrainEngine01b), SetGameHour 336, flips bInDCWasteland / bInNVWasteland / TTWWorldLocation and calls TTWFNEnable/DisableDCWasteland / NVWasteland. When VCG00 has not started (a Fallout 3 start) the same trip is the '3 years later' move into New Vegas: Player.MoveTo TTWHoldingCellPlayerXMarkerREF, player.RemoveAllItems TTWStolenWeaponsRef, StartQuest VCG00. Without a party warp only the host changes wasteland. OPEN (needs a decision): how RemoveAllItems into TTWStolenWeaponsRef should apply to each player's own inventory (Dead Money's bunker has the same pending 'inventory-stash' question).
The same script holds DisablePlayerControls 1 0 0 0 0 0 0 for the ride (fade, 2 weeks later / 3 years later video) and releases with EnablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 1 1 1.
Stages 5 / 12 DisablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 0 0 1, stages 10 / 20 release.

Character creation spread over a childhood: each player builds their own character, like VCG00 / VCG01 (Doc Mitchell). Stage 0 player.setscale .4 and player.moveto CG01PlayerStartMarker (the baby); stage 100 setscale 1.
CG02 starts from stage 100 for the whole party only when every player has finished.
Stage 5 plays the '1 year later' video inside the scene.
Talking with Dad is per player.
Stages 5 / 60 DisablePlayerControls; 40 / 50 DisablePlayerControls 0 0 1; 10 / 70 release.

Character creation spread over a childhood: each player builds their own character, like VCG00 / VCG01 (Doc Mitchell). The G.O.A.T. exam (CG03Script ShowMessage CG03GoatQuestion01..10 -> setstage CG03Test N) picks each player's tag skills; stages 5 / 100 player.removeallitems + player.additem vaultsuit101 1 1 (the age jumps).
CG04 starts from stage 100 only when every player has taken the exam.
Stage 5 plays the '6 years later' video inside the scene.
Per-player conversations in the classroom.
Stage 0 DisablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 0 0 1 during the '3 years later' video; stage 4 EnablePlayerControls.

Stage 0 player.moveto cg04playerstartmarker. (CG04AmataStartMarker / CG04InterrogationAmataMarker / CG04ReactorGuardStartMarker / CG04AmataAtVaultDoorMarker in the derived rule are NPC moves, dropped here.)
CG04Script advances on player.GetInCell Vault101b and on leaving Vault101: the escape is played together.
GetInCell checks in CG04Script; IsActionRef on the vault-door and terminal scripts.
Stages 2 / 8 / 10 / 50 player.additem vaultsuit101, weap10mmPistol, ammo10mm, lockpick: every player gets them.
Quest items handed out during the escape go to every player.
Karma choices (Butch, Amata, the Overseer) are shared (one story).
Whoever starts a conversation picks the lines.
MQ04Script acts when player.GetInCell Vault112a: everyone enters the pods together.

MQ04Script Player.moveto MQ04StartBench (into Tranquility Lane); the pod exit uses MQ04PlayerPod. (CitTheDenMARKER in the derived rule is Sarah's move, dropped.) OPEN: Player.RemoveAllItems MQ04PlayerContainerRef has to stash each player's own inventory (same pending 'inventory-stash' question as Dead Money's bunker).
MQ04Script EnablePlayerControls after the move: the release reaches every player.
Companions wait outside the simulation; recruiter keeps them.
GetInCell / GetInWorldSpace TranquilityLane, IsKiller (Betty's tasks), GetDistance in the quest scripts.
Tranquility Lane's karma choices are one story.
player.additem MQ04PlayerOutfit and the XP reward (stage 200 RewardXP 600) go to every player.
Quest items go to every player.
Betty / residents: the initiator picks.

MQ09Script Player.moveto MQ09PlayerStartMark: the Enclave captures the party (the other markers in the derived rule are NPC moves, dropped). OPEN: Player.RemoveAllItems MQ09PlayerContainerRef1 has to stash each player's own items.
MQ09Script DisablePlayerControls 1 1 1 1 0 1 1 for Autumn's interrogation.
No saving inside the capture scene.
Fawkes / followers are moved to FawkesWaitMarker; recruiter keeps them.
IsActionRef / GetDistance / GetInSameCell in the quest scripts.
Shared karma.
RewardXP 100 / 1100 to every player.
Player.RemoveItem MQ08GECK: the G.E.C.K. is a quest item every player holds; it is taken from all.
Autumn / Eden: the initiator picks.

open: MQ11 / EndingBinks (Fallout3.esm:068A9F), provisional default: the player who enters the purifier code dies (the original object script MQ11PPurityControlPanelScript, run by the host) and every player sees the ending: EndingBinksScript's PlayBink is the story-capture event op kOpPlayBink (needs [hooks] story_capture=1). Change it if the owner decides otherwise.

Inventory stash: built as the ContainerTransfer effect (each player's own items through their own copy of the container); proven in game on The Pitt's DLC01Quest02 stage 0 / 170 and on TTWTrainTripQuest's Fallout 3 start branch. Not yet run in game: Operation Anchorage, Mothership Zeta, MQ04, MQ09, Dead Money's bunker.
